youtube.title: Why Charger Cables Have a Lump 🔌 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The cylinder on many charger and monitor cables is a ferrite bead, a small block of magnetic ceramic. Cables act like antennas, picking up and radiating high-frequency electrical noise. The ferrite absorbs that noise and turns it into a tiny amount of heat. This keeps devices and nearby electronics, like speakers and radios, from being disturbed.
